items.title: Measuring LLMs' Impact on N-day Exploits
items.content:
In cybersecurity, a large fraction of real-world harm comes from N-days: vulnerabilities that have
                    already been publicly disclosed, but only patched on some devices. In this post, we evaluate how
                    much large language models can accelerate and automate the process of developing N-day exploits.
items.contentSnippet:

                    much large language models can accelerate and automate the process of developing N-day exploits.

summaries.zh:
文章标题：衡量大型语言模型对N天漏洞的影响

文章内容摘要：在网络安全领域，大部分实际损害来自N天漏洞——即已公开披露但部分设备未修复的漏洞。本文评估了大型语言模型在加速和自动化N天漏洞开发过程中的作用。
summaries.en: The article assesses how large language models (LLMs) impact the development of N-day exploits in cybersecurity. N-days refer to vulnerabilities publicly disclosed but patched on only some devices, causing significant real-world harm. The post evaluates the extent to which LLMs can accelerate and automate the creation of these exploits.

items.title: Mapping AI-enabled cyber threats: Insights from the LLM ATT&CK Navigator
items.content:
We’ve spent the past year investigating how threat actors are weaponizing AI to conduct cyber
                        operations. Today, we’re sharing a new analysis that maps these real-world attacks onto the
                        MITRE ATT&CK framework, a database of tactics and techniques used by cyberattackers. We
                        partnered with Verizon to include some of these results in the 2026 Verizon Data Breach
                        Investigation Report (DBIR), and are publishing this report to offer a longer-form analysis of
                        trends we are seeing in AI-enabled cyber operations.

summaries.zh: 本文分析了威胁行为者如何利用人工智能进行网络攻击，并将真实攻击案例映射到MITRE ATT&CK框架。研究团队与Verizon合作，部分结果被纳入2026年《Verizon数据泄露调查报告》，以深入探讨AI赋能网络攻击的趋势。
summaries.en: The article presents a new analysis mapping AI-enabled cyber threats onto the MITRE ATT&CK framework. It highlights how threat actors are using AI in cyber operations, based on real-world attacks. The findings were also included in the 2026 Verizon DBIR. The report offers a detailed analysis of trends in AI-powered cyber threats.

items.title: Measuring LLMs' Ability to Develop Exploits
items.content:
On two new, challenging academic benchmarks measuring AI models’ ability to develop exploits
                        (ExploitBench and ExploitGym) and an updated version of the benchmark measuring smart contract
                        exploitation (SCONE-bench), we have found that Mythos Preview consistently outperforms all other
                        evaluated models. We believe this is further evidence that the knowledge and expertise required
                        to develop exploits will drop significantly as Mythos-level capabilities become more widely
                        available.
items.contentSnippet:
On two new, challenging academic benchmarks measuring AI models’ ability to develop exploits
                        (ExploitBench and ExploitGym) and an updated version of the benchmark measuring smart contract
                        exploitation (SCONE-bench), we have found that Mythos Preview consistently outperforms all other
                        evaluated models. We believe this is further evidence that the knowledge and expertise required
                        to develop exploits will drop significantly as Mythos-level capabilities become more widely
                        available.

summaries.zh: 文章介绍了两个新的学术基准（ExploitBench和ExploitGym）以及更新版的智能合约漏洞利用基准（SCONE-bench），用于评估AI模型开发漏洞的能力。研究发现，Mythos Preview在这些基准测试中表现优于其他模型。这表明，随着Mythos级能力的普及，开发漏洞所需的知识和技能将大幅降低。
summaries.en: The study evaluates AI models using ExploitBench, ExploitGym, and SCONE-bench for exploit development. Mythos Preview outperforms all other models across these benchmarks. The findings suggest that as Mythos-level AI capabilities become more accessible, the expertise needed to create exploits will significantly decrease. The research highlights the growing potential for AI in developing exploits.

items.title: Assessing Claude Mythos Preview’s cybersecurity capabilities
items.content:
Claude Mythos Preview is a new general-purpose language model that is
                        strikingly capable at computer security tasks. This post provides technical details for
                        researchers
                        and practitioners who want to understand exactly how we have been testing this model, and what
                        we
                        have found over the past month. We hope this will show why we view this as a watershed moment
                        for
                        security, and why we have chosen to begin a coordinated effort to reinforce the world’s cyber
                        defenses.

summaries.zh: Claude Mythos Preview是一款在计算机安全任务中表现出色的通用语言模型。本文为研究人员和从业者提供了技术细节，解释了测试该模型的过程及过去一个月的发现。文章强调，该模型标志着安全领域的转折点，并呼吁启动协调行动以加强全球网络安全防御。
summaries.en: Claude Mythos Preview is a new general-purpose language model with strong computer security capabilities. The article provides technical details on testing methods and findings over the past month, highlighting its significance for cybersecurity. It aims to demonstrate why the model represents a pivotal moment for security and justifies efforts to enhance global cyber defenses.

items.content:
In a collaboration with researchers at Mozilla, Claude Opus
                        4.6 discovered 22 Firefox vulnerabilities over the course of two weeks.

items.title: Reverse engineering Claude's CVE-2026-2796 exploit
items.content:
This post dives deep into how Claude wrote an exploit for one of the vulnerabilities it found in
                        Firefox.

This post dives deep into how Claude wrote an exploit for one of the vulnerabilities it found in

items.title: LLM-discovered 0-days
items.content:
AI models can now find high-severity vulnerabilities at scale. This is a moment to empower
                        defenders. We're now using Claude to find and help fix vulnerabilities in open source software.
items.contentSnippet:
AI models can now find high-severity vulnerabilities at scale. This is a moment to empower
                        defenders. We're now using Claude to find and help fix vulnerabilities in open source software.

summaries.zh: AI模型已能大规模发现高危漏洞。当前应赋能防御者。我们正使用Claude检测并协助修复开源软件中的漏洞。
summaries.en: AI models like Claude can identify high-severity vulnerabilities in software at scale. This capability enables defenders to address security issues more effectively. Currently, Claude is being employed to detect and resolve vulnerabilities in open-source software, enhancing overall security.

items.title: AI Models on Realistic Cyber Ranges
items.content:
In a recent evaluation of AI models’ cyber capabilities, current Claude models can now succeed
                        at multistage attacks on networks with dozens of hosts using only standard, open-source tools,
                        instead of the custom tools needed by previous generations.
items.contentSnippet:
In a recent evaluation of AI models’ cyber capabilities, current Claude models can now succeed
                        at multistage attacks on networks with dozens of hosts using only standard, open-source tools,
                        instead of the custom tools needed by previous generations.

summaries.zh: 近期评估显示，当前Claude AI模型在真实网络环境中展现出显著提升的攻防能力。它们仅需标准开源工具，即可成功实施多阶段网络攻击，而无需依赖以往所需的定制化工具。这一突破表明Claude模型在网络安全领域的应用潜力日益增强。
summaries.en: Recent evaluations show that current Claude AI models can now perform multistage attacks on networks with dozens of hosts using only standard, open-source tools. This capability replaces the need for custom tools required by previous AI generations, indicating improved cyber capabilities in these models.

items.summary: 近期评估显示，当前Claude AI模型在真实网络环境中展现出显著提升的攻防能力。它们仅需标准开源工具，即可成功实施多阶段网络攻击，而无需依赖以往所需的定制化工具。这一突破表明Claude模型在网络安全领域的应用潜力日益增强。

items.title: Finding Bugs with Claude and Property-based Testing
items.content:
Ensuring that programs are bug-free is one of the most challenging aspects of software
                        engineering. We developed an agent that can efficiently identify bugs in large software
                        projects. Our agent infers general properties of code that should be true, and then applies
                        property-based testing. After extensive manual validation, we are in the process of reporting
                        bugs in top Python packages to their developers, several of which have already been patched.
items.contentSnippet:
Ensuring that programs are bug-free is one of the most challenging aspects of software
                        engineering. We developed an agent that can efficiently identify bugs in large software
                        projects. Our agent infers general properties of code that should be true, and then applies
                        property-based testing. After extensive manual validation, we are in the process of reporting
                        bugs in top Python packages to their developers, several of which have already been patched.

summaries.zh: 本文介绍了一种利用Claude工具进行属性驱动测试的bug检测方法。该方法通过推断代码中应满足的通用属性，并应用属性驱动测试来高效识别大型软件项目中的bug。经过人工验证，该工具已在多个顶级Python包中发现并报告了部分bug，其中一些已被开发者修复。
summaries.en: The article introduces an agent designed to identify bugs in large software projects. The agent infers general properties of code and applies property-based testing. After manual validation, it has successfully reported bugs in top Python packages to their developers, with some patches already implemented. The focus is on improving software reliability through automated bug detection.

items.title: Experimenting with AI to Defend Critical Infrastructure
items.content:
AI could help defenders of critical infrastructure identify the vulnerabilities that attackers
                    might
                    exploit—and close them before they are exploited. Anthropic has partnered with Pacific Northwest
                    National Laboratory (PNNL) to explore this defensive application of AI, demonstrating both the
                    potential of AI-accelerated defense and the value of public-private partnerships in harnessing
                    AI
                    for national security.
items.contentSnippet:
AI could help defenders of critical infrastructure identify the vulnerabilities that attackers
                    might
                    exploit—and close them before they are exploited. Anthropic has partnered with Pacific Northwest
                    National Laboratory (PNNL) to explore this defensive application of AI, demonstrating both the
                    potential of AI-accelerated defense and the value of public-private partnerships in harnessing
                    AI
                    for national security.

summaries.zh: 人工智能可用于帮助关键基础设施防御者识别潜在漏洞并提前修复。Anthropic公司与太平洋西北国家实验室（PNNL）合作探索AI的防御应用，展示了AI加速防御的潜力及公私合作在利用AI保障国家安全方面的价值。
summaries.en: AI can assist in identifying and mitigating vulnerabilities in critical infrastructure before they are exploited by attackers. Anthropic has partnered with the Pacific Northwest National Laboratory (PNNL) to explore this defensive use of AI, showcasing its potential for accelerated defense and the importance of public-private collaboration in leveraging AI for national security.

items.title: Project Vend: Phase Two
items.content:
In June, we revealed that we'd set up a small shop in our San Francisco office run by an AI
                    shopkeeper. It did not do particularly well. We made some adjustments for phase two of Project Vend.
                    The idea of an AI running a business doesn't seem as far-fetched as it once did. But the gap between
                    'capable' and 'completely robust' remains wide.

summaries.zh: 项目“Vend”第二阶段：人工智能商店表现不佳，团队进行调整。此前在旧金山办公室设立的由AI店员运营的小店效果不理想。尽管AI经营企业的想法不再遥远，但其在“能力”与“完全可靠”之间仍有差距。
summaries.en: Project Vend's Phase Two involves adjustments to an AI-run shopkeeper in San Francisco after Phase One underperformed. While the concept of AI in business is becoming more feasible, significant gaps in capability remain.

items.title: AI Agents Find Smart Contract Exploits
items.content:
We evaluated AI agents' ability to exploit smart contracts using a new benchmark comprising
                    contracts that were actually exploited. On contracts exploited after the latest knowledge cutoffs,
                    Claude Opus 4.5, Claude Sonnet 4.5, and GPT-5 found vulnerabilities worth a combined $4.6 million, a
                    finding that underscores the need for proactive adoption of AI for defense.
items.contentSnippet:
We evaluated AI agents' ability to exploit smart contracts using a new benchmark comprising
                    contracts that were actually exploited. On contracts exploited after the latest knowledge cutoffs,
                    Claude Opus 4.5, Claude Sonnet 4.5, and GPT-5 found vulnerabilities worth a combined $4.6 million, a
                    finding that underscores the need for proactive adoption of AI for defense.

summaries.zh: 本文评估了AI代理利用智能合约的能力，使用了一个包含实际被利用合约的新基准。在最新知识截止日期后被利用的合约中，Claude Opus 4.5、Claude Sonnet 4.5和GPT-5发现了总价值460万美元的漏洞，这一发现强调了主动采用AI进行防御的必要性。
summaries.en: AI agents successfully identified vulnerabilities in exploited smart contracts, uncovering flaws worth $4.6 million. The evaluation used real-world exploited contracts post-knowledge cutoffs. Results showed Claude Opus 4.5, Claude Sonnet 4.5, and GPT-5 detected these issues. The findings highlight the importance of using AI for proactive smart contract security.

items.title: Project Fetch
items.content:
How could frontier AI models like Claude reach beyond computers and affect the physical world? One
                    path is through robots. We ran an experiment to see how much Claude helped Anthropic staff perform
                    complex tasks with a robot dog.
items.contentSnippet:
How could frontier AI models like Claude reach beyond computers and affect the physical world? One
                    path is through robots. We ran an experiment to see how much Claude helped Anthropic staff perform
                    complex tasks with a robot dog.

summaries.zh: 《Project Fetch》探讨了前沿AI模型Claude如何通过机器人影响物理世界。实验显示，Claude显著提升了Anthropic团队使用机器人狗完成复杂任务的能力。
summaries.en: "Project Fetch explores how AI model Claude can extend its capabilities beyond computers by assisting with physical tasks through robots. An experiment was conducted to assess Claude's effectiveness in helping Anthropic staff operate a robot dog for complex tasks. The study evaluates the integration of AI in robotics to bridge the gap between digital and physical interactions."

items.summary: 《Project Fetch》探讨了前沿AI模型Claude如何通过机器人影响物理世界。实验显示，Claude显著提升了Anthropic团队使用机器人狗完成复杂任务的能力。

items.title: Building AI for Cyber Defenders
items.content:
We invested in improving Claude's ability to help defenders detect, analyze, and remediate
                        vulnerabilities in code and deployed systems. This work allowed Claude Sonnet 4.5 to match
                        or
                        eclipse Opus 4.1 in discovering code vulnerabilities and other cyber skills. Adopting and
                        experimenting with AI will be key for defenders to keep pace.
items.contentSnippet:
We invested in improving Claude's ability to help defenders detect, analyze, and remediate
                        vulnerabilities in code and deployed systems. This work allowed Claude Sonnet 4.5 to match
                        or
                        eclipse Opus 4.1 in discovering code vulnerabilities and other cyber skills. Adopting and
                        experimenting with AI will be key for defenders to keep pace.

summaries.zh: 我们投资提升了Claude在帮助防御者检测、分析和修复代码及系统漏洞方面的能力。Claude Sonnet 4.5在发现代码漏洞和其他网络安全技能方面与Opus 4.1相当甚至超越。采用和实验AI将是防御者保持竞争力的关键。
summaries.en: The article highlights investments in enhancing Claude's capabilities to assist cyber defenders in detecting, analyzing, and remediating vulnerabilities in code and deployed systems. Claude Sonnet 4.5 was developed to match or surpass Opus 4.1 in identifying code vulnerabilities and other cyber skills. The article emphasizes that adopting and experimenting with AI is crucial for defenders to stay competitive in cybersecurity.

items.summary: 我们投资提升了Claude在帮助防御者检测、分析和修复代码及系统漏洞方面的能力。Claude Sonnet 4.5在发现代码漏洞和其他网络安全技能方面与Opus 4.1相当甚至超越。采用和实验AI将是防御者保持竞争力的关键。

items.title: LLMs and Biorisk
items.content:
Our work at Anthropic is animated by the potential for AI to advance scientific
                    discovery—especially
                    in biology and medicine. At the same time, AI is fundamentally a dual-use technology. This
                    article
                    explains why we believe that evaluating biorisk and safeguarding against it is a critical
                    element
                    of responsible AI development.
items.contentSnippet:
Our work at Anthropic is animated by the potential for AI to advance scientific
                    discovery—especially
                    in biology and medicine. At the same time, AI is fundamentally a dual-use technology. This
                    article

                    element

summaries.zh: Anthropic公司致力于利用AI推动生物和医学领域的科学发现。但AI作为一项具有双重用途的技术，其潜在风险不容忽视。公司认为，评估生物风险并采取防护措施，是负责任AI发展的关键环节。
summaries.en: Anthropic believes AI, particularly large language models (LLMs), can advance biological and medical discovery. However, AI is a dual-use technology, raising concerns about biorisk. The company emphasizes evaluating and safeguarding against biorisk as a key aspect of responsible AI development.

items.title: Developing Nuclear Safeguards for AI
items.content:
Together with the NNSA and DOE national laboratories, we have co-developed a classifier—an
                        AI
                        system
                        that automatically categorizes content—that distinguishes between concerning and benign
                        nuclear-related conversations with high accuracy in preliminary testing.
items.contentSnippet:
Together with the NNSA and DOE national laboratories, we have co-developed a classifier—an
                        AI
                        system
                        that automatically categorizes content—that distinguishes between concerning and benign
                        nuclear-related conversations with high accuracy in preliminary testing.

summaries.zh: 与NNSA和能源部国家实验室合作，我们共同开发了一种分类器——一种自动对内容进行分类的人工智能系统。该系统能以高精度初步测试结果区分出有关和良性的核相关对话。
summaries.en: The article discusses the co-development of an AI classifier by the author, the NNSA, and DOE national laboratories. This system automatically categorizes nuclear-related conversations, distinguishing between concerning and benign discussions with high accuracy in preliminary testing. The focus is on enhancing nuclear safeguards through AI technology.

items.title: Claude Does Cyber Competitions
items.content:
Throughout 2025, we have been quietly entering Claude in cybersecurity competitions designed
                    primarily for humans. In many of these competitions Claude did pretty well, often placing in the
                    top
                    25% of competitors. However, it lagged behind the best human teams at the toughest challenges.
items.contentSnippet:
Throughout 2025, we have been quietly entering Claude in cybersecurity competitions designed
                    primarily for humans. In many of these competitions Claude did pretty well, often placing in the
                    top
                    25% of competitors. However, it lagged behind the best human teams at the toughest challenges.

summaries.zh: 2025年，Claude参加了多项主要面向人类的安全竞赛。在多数比赛中，Claude表现优异，常位列前25%。但在最严峻的挑战中，其表现仍落后于顶尖人类团队。
summaries.en: Claude participated in cybersecurity competitions in 2025, designed for humans. It performed well, frequently ranking in the top 25% of competitors. However, it fell short of the best human teams in the most challenging events.

items.title: Cyber Evaluations of Claude 4
items.content:
We partnered with Pattern Labs on a range of cybersecurity evaluations of Claude Opus 4 and
                    Claude
                    Sonnet 4, with Opus demonstrating especially notable improvement over previous models.
items.contentSnippet:
We partnered with Pattern Labs on a range of cybersecurity evaluations of Claude Opus 4 and
                    Claude
                    Sonnet 4, with Opus demonstrating especially notable improvement over previous models.

summaries.zh: 与Pattern Labs合作，我们对Claude Opus 4和Claude Sonnet 4进行了多项网络安全评估。结果显示，Claude Opus 4在性能上较以往模型有显著提升。
summaries.en: The article discusses cybersecurity evaluations of Claude Opus 4 and Sonnet 4, conducted in collaboration with Pattern Labs. The results highlight significant improvements in Claude Opus 4 compared to previous models. The study focuses on assessing the security performance of these AI models.

items.summary: 与Pattern Labs合作，我们对Claude Opus 4和Claude Sonnet 4进行了多项网络安全评估。结果显示，Claude Opus 4在性能上较以往模型有显著提升。

items.title: Project Vend
items.content:
We let Claude manage an automated store in our office as a small business for about a month. We
                    learned a lot about the plausible, strange, not-too-distant future in which AI models are
                    autonomously running things in the real economy.
items.contentSnippet:
We let Claude manage an automated store in our office as a small business for about a month. We
                    learned a lot about the plausible, strange, not-too-distant future in which AI models are
                    autonomously running things in the real economy.

summaries.zh: 《项目vend》报道，团队让AI模型Claude在办公室管理自动化商店一个月，通过实践深入了解了AI自主运行真实经济场景的未来。实验揭示了AI在商业运营中的可行性、奇特现象及未来趋势，为AI在现实经济中的应用提供了重要参考。
summaries.en: Project Vend involved deploying an AI model, Claude, to manage an automated store in an office for a month. The experiment provided insights into a potential future where AI autonomously operates real-world economic activities.

items.summary: 《项目vend》报道，团队让AI模型Claude在办公室管理自动化商店一个月，通过实践深入了解了AI自主运行真实经济场景的未来。实验揭示了AI在商业运营中的可行性、奇特现象及未来趋势，为AI在现实经济中的应用提供了重要参考。

items.title: Cyber Toolkits for LLMs
items.content:
Large Language Models (LLMs) that are not fine-tuned for cybersecurity can succeed in multistage
                    attacks on networks with dozens of hosts when equipped with a novel toolkit.
items.contentSnippet:
Large Language Models (LLMs) that are not fine-tuned for cybersecurity can succeed in multistage
                    attacks on networks with dozens of hosts when equipped with a novel toolkit.

summaries.zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）若未针对网络安全进行微调，通过配备一种新型工具包，也能在包含数十台主机的网络中成功实施多阶段攻击。该工具包显著提升了LLMs在网络安全领域的攻击能力。
summaries.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) not fine-tuned for cybersecurity can successfully execute multistage attacks on networks with dozens of hosts when equipped with a novel toolkit. The toolkit enhances their capabilities for such tasks.

items.summary: 大型语言模型（LLMs）若未针对网络安全进行微调，通过配备一种新型工具包，也能在包含数十台主机的网络中成功实施多阶段攻击。该工具包显著提升了LLMs在网络安全领域的攻击能力。

items.title: Coordinated Vulnerability Disclosure Dashboard
items.content:
A regularly updated record of vulnerabilities found by Anthropic and reported to maintainers
                        with cryptographic commitments to each finding at the time of disclosure.
items.contentSnippet:
A regularly updated record of vulnerabilities found by Anthropic and reported to maintainers
                        with cryptographic commitments to each finding at the time of disclosure.

summaries.zh: "协同漏洞披露仪表盘"是一个定期更新的记录，记录了Anthropic发现的漏洞，并已向维护者报告。每个发现漏洞时都会附带加密承诺。
summaries.en: The "Coordinated Vulnerability Disclosure Dashboard" is a regularly updated record of vulnerabilities identified by Anthropic and reported to maintainers. Each finding is accompanied by cryptographic commitments at the time of disclosure. The dashboard provides transparency and accountability in the process of vulnerability reporting.
